title: Let’s Simplify Cybersecurity Language with Ayman Elsawah, Founder at Cloud Security Labs
description:
On this episode of No BS Cybersecurity, James is joined by Ayman Elsawah, Fractional CISO and Founder at Cloud Security Labs.

Join them as they delve into:
• Foundational security measures for startups
• Why cybersecurity isn’t black and white - it’s gray
• The need to simplify cybersecurity
• Scenarios startups may find themselves in with security 
• Why security is a journey, not a destination
• And much more!

Ayman Elsawah is the Fractional CISO and Founder at Cloud Security Labs, where he works with B2B SaaS Companies, both early stage and high growth, as well as working personally with many early stage startups and founders. He is also the host of his podcast, Getting Into Infosec, where he interviews people in the field to help educate and inspire those looking to get into Information Security.
